capabilities: Load a global MathJax preamble from a preamble.sty file in the vault root
Enable additional MathJax extensions such as mhchem and bussproofs
Define custom LaTeX macros shared across all notes
extras: Preamble changes only take effect after running 'Reload app without saving'; if preamble.sty is missing at startup the plugin disables itself and must be re-enabled manually. An example vault is provided in examples/stlc.
intentEvidence: This plugin extends the MathJax support in Obsidian with a MathJax preamble file which is loaded at startup.
problem: Obsidian's built-in MathJax support cannot be extended with additional MathJax packages or shared custom LaTeX macros defined once for the whole vault.

relations.evidence: It also enables some additional MathJax extensions (notably mhchem and bussproofs).

summary: MathJax extension loader that enables extra MathJax packages (mhchem, bussproofs) and loads a global preamble.sty of macros at startup.
